The '''Resistance Camp''' was a camp maintained by the [[Resistance]] on the garbage planet of [[Anoat]] [[Time|sometime]] after the [[Battle of Crait]]. While at the camp, [[Lieutenant]] [[Kaydel Ko Connix]] received a general transmission from [[Tah'Nuhna]], which alerted her of the [[First Order]]'s [[Destruction of Tah'Nuhna|attack]] on the [[planet]], which resulted in the base's [[Destruction of Tah'Nuhna|destruction]]. She then proceeded to inform [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Allegiance 1" />
